name: Number of rows in which n appears in Pascal's triangle A007318.
comment: Central binomial coefficients c = A000984(n) > 1 appear once in the middle column C(2n, n), and thereafter in one or more later rows to the left as C(r,k) and to the right as C(r, r-k), k < r/2; the last time in row r = c = C(c,1) = C(c,c-1). For these, a(n) = (A003016(n)+1)/2. For all other numbers n > 1, a(n) = A003016(n)/2. - _M. F. Hasler_, Mar 01 2023
reference: L. Comtet, Advanced Combinatorics, Reidel, 1974, p. 93, #47.

formula: a(A180058(n)) = n and a(m) < n for m < A180058(n); a(A182237(n)) = 2; a(A098565(n)) = 3. - _Reinhard Zumkeller_, Dec 24 2012
example: 6 appears in both row 4 and row 6 in Pascal's triangle, therefore a(6) = 2.
